# Vendored dependency notices

These are unchanged copies of upstream license and notice files. The original
files remain in the source archives. `third_party/sources/inventory.json` records
the original member paths, source URLs, revisions and archive checksums.

Verify copies with `python3 scripts/check-vendored-sources.py`. The Flatpak
installs these notices under `/app/share/licenses/com.compositor.Client/vendored/`.
